form.title: Add a NSW support service
form.summary: Enter the fields below. Examples show what to enter.

fields.label: Service name
fields.hint: Enter the name you want to see in the answer.

fields.label: Condition
fields.hint: Choose the condition already recorded for the older adult in Sarah's scenario.

fields.label: Location
fields.hint: Choose NSW because CQ3 asks about NSW.

fields.label: Phone / demo contact
fields.hint: For a fictional service, use the example rather than a real phone number.

fields.label: Recorded reliable
fields.hint: Choose True to include this fictional service in the reliable-service answer.

fields.label: Assessment source
fields.hint: Enter the source supporting your demo reliability claim.

fields.label: Distance from Mary (km)
fields.hint: Enter the demo distance from Mary; results are ranked by distance.

context: This question uses Sarah's recorded care relationship with Mary.
